sources.title: Multi-Task Learning(MTL) for Deep Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Multi-Task Learning (MTL) is a machine learning approach where a single model learns multiple related tasks simultaneously using shared representations, improving generalization and reducing overfitting.

sources.title: GitHub - ag2ai/SimpleDoc
sources.snippet: SimpleDoc is a lightweight yet powerful Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for multi-modal document understanding, with a focus on Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA). It introduces a dual-cue retrieval mechanism and an iterative reasoning agent that together outperform more complex multi-agent pipelines, using fewer document pages.

sources.title: Designing Multi-Agent Intelligence - Microsoft for Developers
sources.snippet: Our AI Co-Innovation Lab team in San Francisco brought our extensive experience in building gen AI prototypes using Microsoft Azure and AI technologies to collaborate on a multi-agent research and development solution. The Lab team leveraged Azure OpenAI GPT and Azure Cognitive Search for data processing, hypothesis generation, and validation.

sources.title: timlrx/simple-ai-agents: Simple AI agents / assistants - GitHub
sources.snippet: Create simple multi-agent workflows using any LLMs - easy to experiment, use and deploy. The package extends Simple AI Chat by adding support for 100+ LLM providers, structured responses and multiple agents, similar to Autogen.
